Air Suspension Repair
for Range Rover (Vogue)

Compressors, air struts, valve blocks, height sensors and leak tracing for every air-sprung Range Rover and Land Rover.

Book on WhatsApp 055 747 9292

Nothing spoils the Range Rover experience faster than a car that sags overnight or refuses to rise from access height. Air suspension faults are the most common reason owners come to us, and they are also one of the most misdiagnosed. Replacing a compressor when the real fault is a pinhole in a strut bag simply moves the problem along.

Our approach is methodical. We pressurise the system, soap-test every strut, line and fitting, check the valve block, and read compressor run times and duty cycle from the control module before recommending anything. We stock genuine, Dunlop and Arnott air springs and compressors so most repairs are completed the same day.

Air Suspension Repair on the Range Rover (Vogue)

The flagship Range Rover is the reason our workshop exists. From the L322 with its BMW-derived electronics to the aluminium L405 and the current L460, we have serviced and repaired every generation of the full-size Range Rover.

Engines we cover on this model: 3.0 TDV6/SDV6, 4.4 TDV8/SDV8, 5.0 V8 Supercharged, 3.0 Ingenium, P400e PHEV. Production 2002 – present (L322, L405, L460). Faults we see most often on the Range Rover (Vogue) include air suspension compressor and strut leaks, timing chain wear on 3.0 v6 diesel and 5.0 v8, coolant crossover pipe leaks on the v8, and each is diagnosed with the model-specific procedure before any parts are recommended.

What the service includes

  • Full system leak test and pressure hold check
  • Front and rear air strut replacement
  • Compressor, dryer and relay replacement
  • Valve block and pipe repair
  • Height sensor replacement and calibration
  • Suspension module software reset

Signs you need it

  • Vehicle drops on one corner overnight
  • Suspension fault or 'normal height only' warning
  • Compressor running constantly or loudly
  • Vehicle slow to rise from access height
  • Uneven ride height side to side

How we work

Every job begins with a proper diagnosis on the lift and on Land Rover's diagnostic platform. You receive a written report, photos and a fixed price on WhatsApp before any work begins. Genuine or OE-equivalent parts are used, every repair carries a written warranty, and the vehicle is road tested before handover.

Frequently asked questions

Why does my Range Rover sink on one side when parked?

A leaking air spring on that corner is the usual cause. The compressor keeps the car level while it is running, but once parked the air escapes. We can confirm with a soap test in minutes.

Can I convert to coil springs instead?

We can, but we rarely recommend it. Coil conversions remove the ride quality and off-road capability that make the car special. A properly repaired air system is reliable for many years.

How long does an air strut replacement take?

Usually two to three hours per axle including calibration.
